## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Reviewed by the `code-reviewer` agent (`/review`) or by a human with the same checklist
- [ ] Code, comments and test titles are in English; UI text is in French
- [ ] If the shape of persisted data changed: `DATA_VERSION` bumped, migration + legacy fixture + test added
- [ ] No network access, no external resource, no real student data
- [ ] If teachers can see the change: `docs/guide.md` and screenshots updated
